name: Introduction to Earth Science
summary: A first tour of the whole planet as interacting systems of rock, water, air, ice and life, and how Earth scientists study it.

topics.name: How Earth scientists work: observation, hypotheses, models and uncertainty

Earth systems: geosphere, hydrosphere, atmosphere, cryosphere and biosphere
Reservoirs, fluxes, feedbacks and timescales in the Earth system
Earth's layered interior: crust, mantle, core; lithosphere and asthenosphere
Minerals, rocks and the rock cycle
Plate tectonics in outline: plates, boundaries, earthquakes and volcanoes
Deep time: relative and absolute dating and the geologic time scale
The water cycle, oceans and ocean currents in outline
The atmosphere's composition and layers; the Sun as Earth's energy source
Weather versus climate, and what climate change means
Earth resources, natural hazards and human impact on the planet
Reading maps: latitude/longitude, scale, topographic contours and map projections
